title: MCP Gateway
announcement: MCP Gateway is live on Sable. MCP tools, with budgets and policies around them. Every call is metered and receipted. Shipped.
docs_say: Register a third-party MCP server and get a proxy URL; every tools/call through it is allowlist-checked, metered per call and receipted as kind mcp_call.

probes.note: register a server; the docs say session auth, so a routed path answers 401 without one
the proxy path an agent would connect to; the docs say sk-sable_ key auth

control.note: a routed path on the same gateway that answers 401 without a key, so a 404 on the probes is a missing route and not a network problem
